title: Glass Production Planning Software | Workshop Management | Coglass
description: A production board that follows how your workshop works: stations and steps from your own set-up, a tick for every step and pane, outwork tracked while it's away, barcode labels and scanning.
lead: Every line follows its own route through your workshop — cut, edges, toughening, sealing, check & label — built from how you actually work. Tick each step and pane as it's done, see what's out at the processor, and scan barcodes at the bench. And the lead, Georgian and diamond patterns drawn on survey print as a 1:1 template the factory lays the glass straight onto.
steps_h2: From order placed to ready to go — every step tracked
steps_sub: The production board keeps your workshop and your office in sync at all times.
inc_h2: Production tools built for glass workshops
inc_sub: Everything your workshop team needs to stay on top of the queue — without spreadsheets or whiteboards.
steps: Answer three short questions and Coglass builds your stations and processes from your How you work settings — what you cut and finish yourself, and what you buy in or send out. Rename, reorder or add steps whenever you like.
Every line gets its own route

When the job is ordered, each line lands on the board with only the steps it needs: a bought-in pane waits for delivery and a check, a pane you cut goes Cut → Edges & holes → Check & label. A route preview shows which process a product gets, and why.
Tick each step as it's done
The card says what's next and where. Tick it and the card moves on, skipping lanes it doesn't need. Made a mistake? Undo it straight away, or untick the step later.
Glass sent to a processor gets Send out and Back in steps, with the days until it's due back. If it's late, the card turns red with a Chase supplier button.
Each pane of a unit you make has its own card. Assemble & seal stays locked until every pane is in, then the unit goes to Check & label.
When the last step is ticked the card reaches Ready to go. The office is told only when every line of the order is ready, and your automations — a fitting to-do, the collection email — run once.
included: Built from how you work
Stations and steps start from your In-house / Order in answers. Default processes for bought-in, cut-and-finish and sealed-unit work; copy and edit them, or build your own.
A tick for every step
Steps come from the operations on the line — polish, drill, sandblast — plus Cut, Assemble & seal and Check & label. Add your own, such as Wash & inspect or Wrap & rack.
Lanes your workshop uses
To plan, To order, Ordered, Cut, Edges & holes, Toughen & laminate, Decorate, Out for processing, Sealed units, Check & label, Ready to go — the board shows only the ones your routes use.
Outwork and toughening
Send out and Back in steps with the processor and due date, LATE warnings and a Chase supplier button.
Sealed units, pane by pane
A card per pane still to come, and sealing locked until every pane is in.
Rules for the odd job
Send a customer, customer type, job type or operation down a different process when you need to.
Classic board too
We switch the new board on for your company when you're set up. The classic six-lane board stays one click away, and both share the same ticks.
Shop-floor iPad app
Work bench, board and cut list by station on an iPad at the bench, with per-pane ticks and collection sign-off.
Barcode labels and scanning
Barcode labels for every pane. Scan a works-order barcode to tick the next step, or a glass label to book it in — with the iPad camera or a keyboard-wedge yard scanner.
Keeps working offline
The shop-floor app keeps the board on the iPad and syncs changes when the workshop wifi comes back.
Search and needed-by dates
Search by order, customer, supplier or product; needed-by dates from each product's lead time.
Coming soon
A station screen that scans the same glass label at every station, and the Coglass desktop app for workshop PCs — station, counter and deliveries-in modes.
